grain-for-gold.text: The caravan wants grain. They pay well today.

stone-off-a-cart.text: A cart broke an axle. The stone goes cheap.

salted-stores.text: Salted stores from the coast. The granary takes them.

mason-buys-stone.text: A mason from the river towns buys stone at day rates.

grain-for-wall-stone.text: Farmers trade grain for wall stone. Fair enough.
